title: Mikä: identifying or choosing one thing
focus: Use mikä to identify one countable thing or select one item. Mikä tämä on? — Tämä on kirja.
targetSkills: Mikä: identifying or choosing one thing
prerequisiteSkills: Ketkä: asking and answering about several people

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “What is this?”  Ask about one countable thing.
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. Use mikä to identify one countable thing or select one item. Mikä tämä on? (“What is this?”) asks for an identity; Mikä kirja on uusi? (“Which book is new?”) selects a book. The complete question means “What is this”.
requiredSkills: Mikä: identifying or choosing one thing
exercises.targetSkill: Mikä: identifying or choosing one thing

parts.formation: Mikä identifies or selects one thing in its basic form.
